notes.title: Update 5
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33811866/0dd37e77cb1c65d187d60ae6e41af797e061fbf4.png

The game is translated to german now

If your operating system is in one of the supported languages then the game will start in your language automatically

If not (or you want to change language) go to your steam library, right click Bunny Mahjo, select Properties. On the tab General there is a button "Set launch options". Press it and in the window type: "culture="your language""

culture="en" (for english)
culture="ru" (for russian)
culture="fr" (for french)
culture="de" (for german)

Other

 fixed some localized text didn't fit the screen
 fixed the problem with shuffle menu when host and client both had it opened and after the host shuffled the tile the client menu remained on screen

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33811866/a136e563f0241314f1d586e80bc39e1c5cb1247f.jpg
We localized the game to the following languages:
- russian
- french

If your operating system is in one of these languages than the game will start in your language automatically

If not (or you want to change language) go to your steam library, right click Bunny Mahjo, select Properties. On the tab General there is a button "Set launch options". Press it and in the window type: "culture="your language""

culture="en"     (for english)
culture="ru"      (for russian)
culture="fr"       (for french)

If you find any mistakes in translation feel free to let us know in the steam discussians or e-mail and we'll fix it ASAP

P.S.: more languages coming soon
P.P.S.: achievements and the game page are localized too

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
https://media.giphy.com/media/9SIMAtQ9uNPRgzp38R/giphy.gif

- added options to join friends. Now you can see if any friends are playing Bunny Mahjo and you can join them if they play alone. 
- added the number of the left matching pairs 
- added the name of the player to the hall of fame (players sees their own hall of fames with their own achievements) 

Fixes: 
- fixed the leaderboard showed the last puzzle best result after completing the custom puzzle. Now there is no result. 
- fixed the achievements with no hints don't open when the last tile was pressed by the client-bunny 
- fixed the issue with the loading best results at the end of the match from the save in some puzzles 
- fixed that after the client leaves the party the information about him stayed in the hud 

Other:
- reduced the sound of effects of connecting tiles 
- reduces the sound of victory 
- reduces the time of showing the system message to 4 s
- bunny's speed slightly increased
- there won't be the string about best result in custom puzzles anymore
